text: I'm sorry to bother you this late, I've been up with him since about ten and I'm shattered. My grandson, 7, temperature is 39.1. He's got some little dark red spots on his legs and tummy, and I'm not sure but I pressed a glass on them like they say and I don't think they went away, I could still see them through it. He's also looking very pale, blotchy sort of, and his lips look a bit bluey to me, though it could be the lamp, I honestly can't tell anymore. He's got a few insect bites on his arms that he keeps scratching but those look different, more like lumps. What should I do?
